provenance.values_from: work/calibration-diagnostic-047ed4696f52-1/*.json (container wrote them mode 0600; read as root), the lifecycle file, and /var/lib/gpuq/jobs/<job>/{request,result,stderr}

diagnostic.interpretation: isolated single-case replay under CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 passed on all four ranks. The 2026-10-03 unspecified launch failure is therefore not a deterministic single-point fault of this case. A single repetition cannot separate intermittent/scan-order/state-dependent behaviour from a transient device or driver event.

blocking_defect.detail: the container wrote diagnostic-rank*.json, timings-rank*.json and progress-rank*.json as mode 0600 owned by root. A 0600 mode sets the file ACL mask to ---, which masks off the inherited user:gpuq-runner:rwx entry (getfacl shows #effective:---) even though the parent directory carries default:user:gpuq-runner:rwx.
blocking_defect.contrast: artifacts the driver reads successfully elsewhere (cuda-functional.*/rank*.json, checkpoint-rank*.json) are mode 0664
blocking_defect.effect: the driver (gpuq-runner) raised PermissionError at scripts/run_calibration_job.py:103 while reading diagnostic-rank0.json and exited 1
blocking_defect.manual_export_blocked: src/weave/experiment_export.py::export_run requires run_dir/experiment.json, so the documented manual export fallback cannot run either

branch_decision.rule: resume the full experiment only when the command exits 0 and all four ranks report diagnostic_passed
branch_decision.action: stopped before model acceptance and both formal GPQA groups; no full-experiment run was submitted

recommended_fix: keep a wide mode (0644/0664) for container-written JSON or chmod after writing so the inherited gpuq-runner ACL is not masked; alternatively validate the rank reports inside the container and let the driver read only an aggregate file
